title: OutcomeReport
description: The harness contract output (design §5, harness.OutcomeReport) and the body of POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/outcome. A stuck outcome always carries a stuckReason (R4).

failureReason.description: Ploeg's internal failure taxonomy (VIK-597), work.FailureReason. Normally set by the orchestrator; a harness adapter with structured evidence (e.g. an ACP stop reason) may classify its own failure, and the orchestrator's heuristics defer to it.

findings.description: a reading Run's contribution to the blackboard (ADR-0011): markdown prose Ploeg publishes to the pull request and injects into the next Round's briefing. Writers normally omit it.

usage.description: per-run cost/usage (backlog #66) and the harness-native resume handle (backlog #70). The fields after sessionId (ADR-0045) are present only when the harness reported them; a reported zero is sent as zero and an unknown figure is left out.

cacheReadInputTokens.description: input tokens served from the provider's prompt cache

cacheCreationInputTokens.description: input tokens written to the provider's prompt cache

durationMs.description: the harness's own wall-clock time for the Run

apiDurationMs.description: the part of durationMs spent waiting on the model API

toolCallsByKind.description: toolCalls split by the harness's tool kind (for ACP: read, edit, delete, move, search, execute, think, fetch, switch_mode, other)

peakContextTokens.description: the largest context-window fill the harness reported

contextWindowTokens.description: the size of the context window peakContextTokens fills

modelUsage.description: the harness's own split of the Run's usage by model, keyed by model name

verdict.description: a reading Run's answer to whether the work is done (ADR-0017). request_changes re-opens the plan's own writing Round, bounded by the Shift pool, maxFixRounds and the verdict itself. Ignored from a writing Role; it can name no Role, author no Round and raise no budget.

problem.description: a writing Run's account of what was wrong or missing (ADR-0042), markdown for the person who reviews the pull request. It decides nothing. Ignored from a reading Role.

solution.description: a writing Run's account of what it changed and how a reviewer can see it works (ADR-0042), markdown. It decides nothing. Ignored from a reading Role.

createdWorkItems.description: Work Items this Run proposes (Product R12, ADR-0031). Ploeg stores each as a follow_up Work Item that names this Run and its Work Item as its source, within the Team's created-work limits; every entry it rejects is recorded with a reason. Entries wait as proposed until a person approves them unless the Team sets autoDispatch. Optional: a report without it is unchanged.

learnings.description: Proposed knowledge (proposed, OKF knowledge pack proof of concept): what later Runs should know, each in the shape of an OKF concept. The worker writes them as OKF documents for a person to review; none reaches a briefing unreviewed. Optional: a report without it is unchanged.

verification.description: The worker's own run of the configured checks on a fresh checkout of the commit a writing Run pushed, after the harness exited (VIK-1733, ADR-0070). A Work Item reaches awaiting_review only when this record is absent or passed. Only the worker sets it: it discards any value an adapter or agent reported, and ploegd stores it for a writing Run only. Readers take a Run's verification result and commit from this record, never from the summary or findings prose. ploegd refuses a report whose record contradicts itself: a passed record needs at least one check, a passed check exit code 0 and a failed one a nonzero exit code, a check that ran start and finish times inside the record's, and a check that did not run no exit code or times. Optional: absent means the worker ran no checks (none configured, a reading Run, a cancelled Run or no pull request), which readers show as not recorded. Only a Run ploegd stored before it kept agent_runs.evidence_version (VIK-1780) is read through the prose of its time, labelled historical and unverified.

delivery.description: What the worker read on the forge about the Run's pull request before and after the harness ran (ADR-0059, proposed). Only the worker sets it: an adapter or agent never reports pr_opened, pr_updated, links, a checkpoint, a failure reason, a verification or a delivery. A writer's pr_opened follows observed=opened. ploegd stores it only when it names the Work Item's forge, repository and the Run's branch, and stores observed=unknown otherwise; a writer's pr_opened or pr_updated stands only when the stored record observed that delivery. Optional: a report from an older worker has none.

forge.description: the forge id of the Work Item's target; empty means the default forge

repository.description: owner/name of the Work Item's repository, the only repository a pull request is read from

branch.description: the Run's branch; a pull request counts only when its head is this branch in the same repository (never a fork) and its base is the target's base branch

observed.description: opened: no pull request before the Run, one after; updated: the same pull request before and after and its head commit moved; none: no pull request after, or the same one with the same head; unknown: a forge read failed

head.description: the pull request's head commit after the Run

headBefore.description: the pull request's head commit before the Run, when it was already open

ready.description: Whether the Work Item is Ready: a decided change, or a problem described well enough that a solution can be conceived. A Work Item that is not Ready goes to the Team's refinement target, if one is configured.

team.description: Requested Team. Ploeg accepts only a Team it knows; absent means the source Run's Team.

result.description: failed when a check failed; incomplete when no check failed but the result is not a pass (time limit, cancellation, the checkout was not at the pull request's head, or the branch moved while the checks ran); passed when every check ran and passed on a commit that stayed the pull request's head

commit.description: the full object name of the pushed commit the checks ran on; when they could not run, the pull request's head they were meant for; absent when neither is known

dirty.description: the checkout had uncommitted changes before the checks ran, so the result may not describe commit; always false for a fresh checkout of the pushed commit

stopped.description: why the checks after the last one that ran did not run, or why a verification with no failed check is incomplete

verificationCheck.description: one configured command, in the order the worker ran them; exitCode and the timestamps are present exactly when it ran

exitCode.description: the command's exit status; -1 when it ended without one

type.description: OKF concept type, e.g. Pitfall, Convention, Fact
